findings.title: Database.dbParams() Signature Mismatch
findings.problem: Design calls dbParams() expecting array return, but actual method takes $key parameter and returns string. Code will fail at runtime.

findings.title: Database Class Missing Metadata Properties
findings.problem: Design adds public properties to Database class while claiming 'DO NOT modify existing Database classes'. Direct contradiction. Also inconsistent with Database's private property pattern.
findings.fix: Either store metadata in PreparedStatementBuilder itself (Option A), or explicitly document as breaking change with exact insertion point (Option B)

findings.title: Test Coverage Calculation Unverified
findings.problem: Claims 35% coverage based on unverified assumptions: 324 files × 100 lines × 20% testable = arbitrary. Calculates exact line counts (1,200 lines, 1,105 covered) for code that doesn't exist yet.
findings.fix: Run actual baseline coverage report first. Set targets as percentage increases from measured baseline, not absolute numbers. Measure after implementation, don't guess before.

findings.title: Configuration Loading Order Ambiguity
findings.problem: Says 'add at the beginning' without specifying before which line. No precedence rule when value exists in both .env and .cfg. EnvLoader uses define() but no handling of already-defined constants.
findings.fix: Specify exact line number in configurator.php. Document precedence rule (.cfg overrides .env). Update EnvLoader.loadIntoConfig() to check if(!defined($key)) before defining.

findings.title: PreparedStatementBuilder Execute Return Type Inconsistency
findings.problem: Returns QueryResult|bool but UPDATE with 0 affected rows returns false (looks like error). Line 'return ($affectedRows >= 0 || $insertId > 0)' is wrong.
findings.fix: Return true for successful execution even if 0 rows affected. Only return false on actual errors. Add clear documentation of return semantics.

findings.title: CSRFProtection Token Name Generation Not Session-Safe
findings.problem: Uses SITENAME constant without checking if defined. Will fail in CLI context or early bootstrap. No session_start check before accessing $_SESSION.
findings.fix: Add: $siteName = defined('SITENAME') ? SITENAME : 'logiks'; Check if(!isset($_SESSION)) and return empty token with warning.

findings.title: SecurityHeaders Integration Point Incorrect
findings.problem: Says 'after line 30' but doesn't specify whether inside or outside if(!isset($initialized)) block. Line numbers will shift after session cookie fix.
findings.fix: Use landmark: 'Inside if(!isset($initialized)) block, immediately after include_once commons.php'. Add file_exists() check for phased deployment.

findings.title: InputValidator Regex Rule Array Syntax Unclear
findings.problem: Shows both ['regex' => 'pattern'] and [['regex' => 'pattern']] without explaining double nesting.
findings.fix: Add explicit example showing the array format is for use within a rules array: ['url' => ['required', ['regex' => '/pattern/']]]

findings.title: Type Declaration Migration Strategy Missing Edge Cases
findings.problem: Only shows simple type coercion. No guidance for functions accepting multiple types (string|array) or third-party code calling framework functions.
findings.fix: Add section on functions accepting multiple types (use no type hint for PHP 7.x). Add backward compatibility assertion tests.

findings.title: Missing Error Handling in EnvLoader File Operations
findings.problem: file() call can throw warnings if file becomes unreadable between existence check and read. No try-catch or error suppression.
findings.fix: Use @file() and check for false return: if ($lines === false) { trigger_logikserror(...); return false; }

findings.title: Request Wrapper Missing Content-Type Handling
findings.problem: Only handles form data ($_GET, $_POST). Modern APIs use JSON bodies via php://input. No content-type detection.
findings.fix: Add Request::json() and Request::jsonGet() methods to parse JSON request bodies for API endpoints.

findings.title: PHPUnit Bootstrap Disables Output Buffering
findings.problem: Unconditionally calls ob_end_clean() but Logiks framework uses output buffering. Tests including framework files will have buffering killed.
findings.fix: Remove ob_end_clean() from bootstrap. Let framework manage its own buffering. Use PHPUnit's expectOutputString() for output testing.

findings.title: Security.cfg Example Conflicts with Existing File
findings.problem: Shows adding config but doesn't specify whether to append, replace, or merge with existing security.cfg content.
findings.fix: Specify: 'APPEND to end of config/security.cfg after line 18' with exact content block to add.

summary.recommendation: Design requires rework to fix Database class API assumptions and test coverage measurement approach before implementation can begin.
